name: Famatina
shape: geoBoundaries, the department it is named for

blurb.text: An Argentine geographical indication in La Rioja province that holds the smaller Valle de Chañarmuyo. Malbec is the most planted grape at 39%, followed by Torrontés Riojano at 26%.
